description: Self-hosted file and note sharing that cleans up after itself.

detail.readme:
Tessera

Self-hosted file and note sharing that cleans up after itself.

English · 繁體中文 · 简体中文 · 日本語

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f1c95b78-8561-4184-9616-c57e3fa3bc5a

Upload a file, a folder, a snippet of code or a link, and get back a short code and a URL. Whoever has them can open it until it expires or has been downloaded as many times as you allowed. Then it is deleted. No account is needed to send something, unless you turn that off. Tessera runs as one binary with the web app built in, keeps its data in SQLite, PostgreSQL or MySQL, and stores files on local disk or in object storage. ## Who it is for **Just you, and people you trust.** Run it on a NAS or a home server, behind your VPN, to move files between your own devices or hand them to friends. The defaults suit this: anonymous uploads on, SQLite and local disk, nothing else to set up. See the [personal example](tessera.personal.env.example). **A public instance for strangers.** Anyone can upload, so every resource is spent by people you do not know. Cap the file size and the total storage, shorten the default lifetime, keep sign-up closed or invite-only, and point it at a malware scanner. See the [public example](tessera.public.env.example). **A team or an organization.** Turn anonymous uploads off and let people sign in through your company's OpenID Connect provider. Roles control who may upload, who may see everyone's shares and who may change settings, and each account can have its own quota. PostgreSQL and S3-compatible storage scale past one machine. ## Features ### Under the hood - **Big files can skip your server.** With S3 or Google Cloud Storage behind it, uploads go straight to the bucket and plain downloads are redirected there. A share with a password or a download limit always comes through the server, so those limits still hold. - **Limits that hold under load.** A retrieval is counted in one conditional database update, so two people racing for a one-time share cannot both get it. Expiry is checked on every request, and code lookups are rate-limited. - **Streams instead of buffering.** Memory use stays flat however large the file. - **Storage you can mix.** Local disk, S3-compatible stores, Azure Blob, Google Cloud Storage and WebDAV, several at once, added or retired from the admin panel without a restart. One large file can even be split across buckets (off by default). - **SQLite, PostgreSQL or MySQL**, each with its own hand-written migrations. - **An API to build on.** The OpenAPI contract is generated from the server code, checked in CI and fuzz-tested. The CLI and API tokens use the same endpoints as the web app. - **Quotas and limits** per role, per account and for anonymous uploads together, plus resumable uploads and optional malware scanning. ### For the people using it - **Expiry and download limits.** Each share has a lifetime and, optionally, a maximum number of retrievals. - **Passwords**, required before anything is shown or downloaded. - **Previews.** Code is syntax-highlighted, and images, SVGs and Mermaid diagrams show in the page. Links pasted into chat apps get a preview card. - **Folders and many files**, downloaded together as one archive. - **Accounts when you want them.** Open, invite-only or closed sign-up; passwords, GitHub, Discord or any OpenID Connect provider. - **Interface in English, Traditional Chinese and Japanese.** ## Admin panel

Everything an operator needs is at `/admin`, and nearly every setting takes effect on the next request, without a restart: - **Dashboard:** storage used and where it lives, traffic, trends, and warnings about risky settings. - **Users:** suspend or delete accounts, change roles, set per-account quotas, and end everything one account uploaded. - **Shares:** every share on the instance, including anonymous ones, with who uploaded it. - **Invite codes, roles and permissions.** - **Settings:** sign-in providers, upload limits, expiry defaults, storage backends, email, scanning, link previews and branding. Without a browser, the same settings are available from the command line: `tessera-server settings list`, `settings set `. ## Quick start With Docker: ```bash docker run -d --name tessera --restart unless-stopped \ -p 12923:12923 -v tessera-data:/data ghcr.io/limatura/tessera ``` Then open . On first start the server creates an administrator account and prints its password in the log, once: ```bash docker logs tessera | grep password ``` From a clone of this repository, `docker compose up -d` does the same, with the settings kept in `docker-compose.yml`. Before you put it on the internet, read the [public deployment example](tessera.public.env.example). Anonymous uploads are on by default, and without a storage limit anyone who can reach the server can fill its disk. ### From source You need Rust and pnpm. ```bash pnpm install pnpm --filter web build pnpm server:dev ``` ## Configuration Most settings live in the admin panel. The few that must be known before the server starts, such as the port, the database URL and the data directory, are environment variables: ```bash TESSERA_SERVER__PORT=9000 TESSERA_DATABASE__URL=postgres://tessera:secret@localhost/tessera TESSERA_SERVER__DATA_DIR=/var/lib/tessera ``` Two commented starting points: [a personal instance](tessera.personal.env.example) and [a public one](tessera.public.env.example). For systemd there is a [unit file](contrib/tessera.service). ### Storage Files go to a local directory unless you add another backend in the admin panel. | Backend | Notes | | --- | --- | | Local disk | The default | | S3-compatible | Tested against MinIO, Garage, RustFS, SeaweedFS, VersityGW and s3proxy. AWS S3, Cloudflare R2 and Backblaze B2 are checked when credentials are available. | | Azure Blob Storage | Tested against Azurite | | Google Cloud Storage | Built in, not yet covered by tests | | WebDAV | Small files only, up to `share.inline_threshold_bytes` (64 KiB by default) | ## Command-line client Install `tess` for Linux or macOS. Windows builds are on the [releases page](https://github.com/Limatura/tessera/releases), and `cargo install --path apps/cli` builds it from source. ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Limatura/tessera/main/scripts/install.sh | sh ``` Until there is a stable release, add `-s -- --version ` with the release you want. ```bash tess login https://share.example.com tess send report.pdf --expires 24 tess get https://share.example.com/s/P8D72PSF echo "hello" | tess send - tess ls tess rm P8D72PSF tess ``` `tess` on its own opens a full-screen view to find files and send them without typing paths, and to manage your shares.

`--encrypt` seals the content before it leaves your machine; the key is the part of the link after `#`, which the server never sees. No CLI at hand? `curl` will do, and prints the link: ```bash curl -T report.pdf https://share.example.com/ echo "hello" | curl -T - https://share.example.com/ ``` Options go in headers: `-H 'X-Share-Expires: 1d'`, `-H 'X-Share-Max-Downloads: 3'`, `-H 'X-Share-Password: …'`. ## Documentation - [User and operator guide](https://github.com/Limatura/tessera-docs) - [Server internals](apps/server/README.md), and the design notes in [docs/](docs/README.md) - [API contract](openapi.json), generated from the server code ## Contributing See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). Security problems go through [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md), not the issue tracker. ## License [AGPL-3.0](LICENSE). If you run a modified Tessera for other people, you must offer them its source.
detail.readme_zh:
Tessera

自托管的文件与文本分享服务，用完会自己清理。

English · 繁體中文 · 简体中文 · 日本語

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f1c95b78-8561-4184-9616-c57e3fa3bc5a

上传文件、文件夹、一段代码或一个链接，就会得到一个简短的取件码和网址。拿到的人可以打开它，直到它过期，或下载次数达到你设定的上限，之后它就会被删除。 发送东西不需要账号，除非你关闭这个功能。Tessera 是单个可执行文件，网页界面直接内嵌其中；数据存放在 SQLite、PostgreSQL 或 MySQL，文件放在本地磁盘或对象存储。 ## 适合谁用 **自己和信任的人用。** 部署在 NAS 或家用服务器上、放在 VPN 后面，在自己的设备之间传文件，或发给朋友。默认值就是为这种情况设计的：开启匿名上传、SQLite 加本地磁盘，其他都不用配置。参考[个人使用的示例配置](tessera.personal.env.example)。 **向陌生人开放的公共实例。** 任何人都能上传，所以这台机器的每一份资源都在被陌生人使用。限制单个文件大小和总容量、缩短默认保留时间、保持关闭注册或改为邀请制，并接入恶意软件扫描。参考[公共实例的示例配置](tessera.public.env.example)。 **团队或组织。** 关闭匿名上传，让大家用公司的 OpenID Connect 登录。用角色控制谁能上传、谁能查看所有人的分享、谁能修改设置，每个账号也可以单独设置容量上限。需要不止一台机器时，可以换成 PostgreSQL 和 S3 兼容存储。 ## 功能 ### 底层设计 - **大文件可以不经过你的服务器。** 接入 S3 或 Google Cloud Storage 后，上传会直接写入 bucket，普通下载也会直接重定向到 bucket。有密码或下载次数限制的分享一律经过服务器，所以这些限制依然有效。 - **限制在高负载下也守得住。** 每次取件都用一条带条件的数据库更新来计数，两个人同时抢一次性分享，不会两人都拿到。每个请求都会检查期限，查询取件码也有限流。 - **流式传输，不先整个读入内存。** 无论文件多大，内存占用都保持平稳。 - **存储后端可以混用。** 本地磁盘、S3 兼容存储、Azure Blob、Google Cloud Storage 和 WebDAV，可以同时使用多个，在后台添加或停用都无需重启。大文件甚至可以拆分到多个 bucket 存储（默认关闭）。 - **支持 SQLite、PostgreSQL 或 MySQL**，每种数据库都有各自手写的迁移脚本。 - **可以用来开发的 API。** OpenAPI 规范由服务器代码生成，CI 会检查并做模糊测试。命令行工具和 API token 使用与网页界面相同的端点。 - **容量与限制**可以按角色、按账号设置，也能限制所有匿名上传的总量；此外支持断点续传，可选接入恶意软件扫描。 ### 使用上 - **期限与下载次数。** 每个分享都有保留时间，也可以限制最多被取几次。 - **密码**，输入正确才能看到内容或下载。 - **预览。** 代码带语法高亮，图片、SVG 和 Mermaid 图表直接显示在页面上。链接粘贴到聊天软件时会生成预览卡片。 - **文件夹与多个文件**，可以打包成一个压缩包下载。 - **需要时再用账号。** 注册可以设置为开放、邀请制或关闭；可以用密码、GitHub、Discord 或任意 OpenID Connect 登录。 - **界面提供英文、繁体中文和日文。** ## 管理后台

管理所需的一切都在 `/admin`，几乎所有设置修改后下一个请求就生效，无需重启： - **仪表盘：** 用了多少空间、存在哪里、流量和趋势，以及有风险的设置提醒。 - **用户：** 停用或删除账号、调整角色、设置单个账号的容量上限，也能一次结束某个账号上传的所有分享。 - **分享：** 实例上的所有分享，包括匿名上传的，以及上传者是谁。 - **邀请码、角色与权限。** - **设置：** 登录方式、上传限制、默认期限、存储后端、电子邮件、扫描、链接预览和外观。 没有浏览器时，同样的设置也可以用命令修改：`tessera-server settings list`、`settings set `。 ## 快速开始 使用 Docker： ```bash docker run -d --name tessera --restart unless-stopped \ -p 12923:12923 -v tessera-data:/data ghcr.io/limatura/tessera ``` 然后打开 。首次启动时，服务器会创建一个管理员账号，并把密码打印在日志里，只打印一次： ```bash docker logs tessera | grep password ``` 在本仓库的克隆中执行 `docker compose up -d` 效果相同，配置保存在 `docker-compose.yml` 里。 开放到公网之前，请先阅读[公共实例的示例配置](tessera.public.env.example)。匿名上传默认开启，没有设置容量上限的话，任何能访问这台服务器的人都能把磁盘写满。 ### 从源码运行 需要 Rust 和 pnpm。 ```bash pnpm install pnpm --filter web build pnpm server:dev ``` ## 配置 大部分设置都在管理后台。少数必须在服务器启动前确定的，例如端口、数据库地址和数据目录，用环境变量设置： ```bash TESSERA_SERVER__PORT=9000 TESSERA_DATABASE__URL=postgres://tessera:secret@localhost/tessera TESSERA_SERVER__DATA_DIR=/var/lib/tessera ``` 有两份带注释的示例可以作为起点：[个人使用](tessera.personal.env.example)和[公共实例](tessera.public.env.example)。使用 systemd 的话有现成的 [unit 文件](contrib/tessera.service)。 ### 存储 文件默认存放在本地目录，要使用其他存储后端可以在管理后台添加。 | 存储后端 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | 本地磁盘 | 默认 | | S3 兼容存储 | 已用 MinIO、Garage、RustFS、SeaweedFS、VersityGW 和 s3proxy 测试。提供凭证时，也会测试 AWS S3、Cloudflare R2 和 Backblaze B2。 | | Azure Blob Storage | 已用 Azurite 测试 | | Google Cloud Storage | 已内置，但尚未被测试覆盖 | | WebDAV | 仅支持小文件，上限为 `share.inline_threshold_bytes`（默认 64 KiB） | ## 命令行工具 在 Linux 或 macOS 安装 `tess`。Windows 版在 [releases 页面](https://github.com/Limatura/tessera/releases)；也可以用 `cargo install --path apps/cli` 从源码编译。 ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Limatura/tessera/main/scripts/install.sh | sh ``` 正式版发布之前，请在后面加上 `-s -- --version <版本>`。 ```bash tess login https://share.example.com tess send report.pdf --expires 24 tess get https://share.example.com/s/P8D72PSF echo "hello" | tess send - tess ls tess rm P8D72PSF tess ``` 只输入 `tess` 会打开全屏界面，不用输入路径就能找文件、发送，也能管理自己的分享。

加上 `--encrypt` 会在内容离开你的电脑之前先加密，密钥是链接中 `#` 后面的部分，服务器永远看不到。 手边没有 CLI？用 `curl` 也可以，会直接打印链接： ```bash curl -T report.pdf https://share.example.com/ echo "hello" | curl -T - https://share.example.com/ ``` 选项放在 header：`-H 'X-Share-Expires: 1d'`、`-H 'X-Share-Max-Downloads: 3'`、`-H 'X-Share-Password: …'`。 ## 文档 - [使用与部署指南](https://github.com/Limatura/tessera-docs) - [服务器内部说明](apps/server/README.md)，以及 [docs/](docs/README.md) 中的设计笔记 - [API 规范](openapi.json)，由服务器代码生成 ## 参与贡献 请阅读 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)。安全问题请按照 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) 私下报告，不要提交 issue。 ## 许可证 [AGPL-3.0](LICENSE)。如果你修改了 Tessera 并提供给他人使用，必须让他们能获取修改后的源代码。
